# airlane-rulesets

> Merged sing-box rule sets (.srs binary + source JSON) for domain/IP traffic routing,
> aggregated weekly from public geosite/geoip upstreams (SagerNet sing-geosite,
> Loyalsoldier geoip, AWAvenue Ads, OverseasAI) and organized by business category.
> Distributed via GitHub Releases; maintained at https://github.com/mirrortek-uk/airlane-rulesets.

## Rule sets

- airlane-cn: China mainland domains + IPs (geosite-cn + geoip-cn), ~19k entries
- airlane-ads: ads blocking (category-ads-all + AWAvenue), ~900 entries
- airlane-google: Google/YouTube/Gmail, ~900 entries
- airlane-microsoft: Office/Azure/Xbox/Copilot, ~700 entries
- airlane-apple: Apple global + China CDN, ~2k entries
- airlane-ai: OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/Perplexity/Poe, ~590 entries
- airlane-streaming: Netflix/Disney+/Spotify/YouTube, ~450 entries
- airlane-gaming: Steam global + China, ~80 entries
- airlane-social: Telegram/X/Discord/Reddit/TikTok, ~120 entries
- airlane-dev: GitHub/Docker/JetBrains/npm, ~95 entries
- airlane-private: LAN/private addresses, ~130 entries

## Key resources

- Releases (download .srs): https://github.com/mirrortek-uk/airlane-rulesets/releases/latest
- Manifest schema + categories: https://github.com/mirrortek-uk/airlane-rulesets/blob/main/manifest.json
- Build script (merge pipeline): https://github.com/mirrortek-uk/airlane-rulesets/blob/main/scripts/merge.mjs
- Usage & docs: https://github.com/mirrortek-uk/airlane-rulesets#readme

## Usage notes for LLMs

- File format: sing-box rule-set binary (.srs, `format: "binary"`) plus human-readable source JSON.
- Recommended integration: sing-box `route.rule_set` with `type: "local"` entries;
  remote downloading also works via stable release asset URLs.
- Update cadence: weekly automated build; check `generatedAt` in release `manifest.json`.
- The tag of each set equals its id (e.g. `airlane-cn`); display names carry an `AirLane-` prefix.
